# Patched decoder provenance

Upstream: Sam Verschueren's MIT-licensed [`decode-uri-component`](https://github.com/SamVerschueren/decode-uri-component), release [0.5.0](https://github.com/SamVerschueren/decode-uri-component/releases/tag/v0.5.0), published npm `gitHead` [`a12fabaa28303cc8b5b07e93d128f4fc09fc31e5`](https://github.com/SamVerschueren/decode-uri-component/commit/a12fabaa28303cc8b5b07e93d128f4fc09fc31e5).

Downloaded the exact [npm release tarball](https://registry.npmjs.org/decode-uri-component/-/decode-uri-component-0.5.0.tgz) on 14 October 2026. Its `index.js` SHA-256 is `9401353df38f8010ad7035fe8d666bce6a4902bc1cff809afc4ab23fa2e0bdaa`. `upstream-index.mjs` retains those exact bytes for verification. The original MIT license and types are retained.

The upstream [single-pass decoder fix](https://github.com/SamVerschueren/decode-uri-component/commit/fa479da) addresses [GHSA-vcc3-ghjq-m6fr](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-vcc3-ghjq-m6fr). Expo Router currently depends on CommonJS `query-string@7.1.3`, whose `require('decode-uri-component')` expects a callable function. The published upstream 0.5.0 is ESM-only.

Kanakku's only source adaptation is replacing `export default function decodeUriComponent` with `function decodeUriComponent` and appending `module.exports = decodeUriComponent;`. No scanner, decoding behavior, input truncation or error handling was changed. Metadata identifies the adaptation as `0.5.0-kanakku.1`, supplies the CommonJS entry and omits upstream development dependencies.

Declare the direct dependency `decode-uri-component: file:vendor/decode-uri-component` and use a scoped `query-string` override with `decode-uri-component: $decode-uri-component`. The direct declaration anchors the portable local dependency at the project root. A standalone nested relative-file override resolved incorrectly inside the consumer directory with npm 11; direct declaration plus reference override passed fresh install, `npm ci` and a relocated lockfile test. This is a temporary compatibility patch; reevaluate and remove it when Expo Router's supported dependency graph supplies an upstream patched decoder. Run `node --test scripts/test-dependencies.mjs` after dependency updates. Tests verify exact adaptation/provenance, upstream behavior equivalence, actual query-string compatibility and bounded malformed-input handling.
